review_questions: Does one Phase 4 state machine remain the sole scheduler while Phase 3 supplies only frozen primitives?
Are integer service duration and completion-edge snapping exact and overflow checked?
Are primary and shared-fabric reservations atomic, deterministic and capacity conserving?
Are dependency topology, arrival and completion order independent and fail closed?
Does the complete generated EventIR key and fixed priority registry determine same-time ordering?
Do generated event IDs bind the complete input, service profile and exact authority hashes?
Are build, model contract and checkpoint schema hashes compared against actual immutable artifacts rather than caller labels?
Does checkpoint identity cover every static and derived field using tagged, counted, length-prefixed encoding?
Does restore reject corruption, trailing bytes, invalid enum/map entries and states that are not exact reachable prefixes?
Is ARCH-P4-R2-B1 prospectively closed by exhaustive TraceKind serialization plus in-memory and rehashed-wire negative tests?
Does the fresh R3 run bind the exact current source root and pass Release plus native sanitizer regressions?
Is the reviewed R2 MODIFY candidate preserved as an independently checksummed immutable snapshot?
Is MODEL-P4-R3-B1 closed by excluding only the exact active ledger path and including every nested historical checksum member?
Is the reviewed R3 MODIFY candidate preserved as an independently checksummed immutable snapshot?
Is the stale R1 run excluded and explicitly non-promotable?
Are GPU, model, profiling, calibration and production-scale claims absent?
